verse.verse_1: The event that terrifies the hearts!
verse.verse_2: What is the event that terrifies the hearts?
verse.verse_3: And what have you understood, what the event that terrifies the hearts is!
verse.verse_4: The day when men will be like scattered moths.
verse.verse_5: And mountains will be like flying wool.
verse.verse_6: So for one whose scales prove heavy,
verse.verse_7: He is therefore in the desired bliss.
verse.verse_8: And for one whose scales prove light,
verse.verse_9: He is in the lap of one that abases.
verse.verse_10: And what have you understood, what the one that abases is!
